context: Sho tells Grandma about a holiday outing.
purpose: Casual home register; vocabulary (女の子/ママ/老人/休日/神様) in natural home.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 休日に、ママと神社に行ったよ!
lines.en: On the holiday, I went to a shrine with Mom!
lines.style: excited small child voice, bright warm bouncing delivery throughout

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: まあ、神様にお参りしたのね。
lines.en: Oh, you prayed to the gods.
lines.style: tender grandmother voice, soft warm gentle delivery throughout

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 隣の女の子も、来てたんだ。
lines.en: The girl next door came too.
lines.style: cheerful small child voice, bright warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: その女の子と、仲良くなったの?
lines.en: Did you become friends with that girl?
lines.style: gentle grandmother voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: うん!優しい老人が、飴をくれたよ。
lines.en: Yeah! A kind old man gave us candy.
lines.style: delighted small child voice, bright warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: その老人に、お礼を言った?
lines.en: Did you thank that old man?
lines.style: tender grandmother voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: うん、ママと一緒に言ったよ。
lines.en: Yeah, I said it with Mom.
lines.style: proud small child voice, bright warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 神様も、きっと喜んでいるわ。
lines.en: The gods are surely pleased too.
lines.style: tender grandmother voice, soft warm affectionate closing delivery throughout
